name: Sausage and Fennel Rigatoni

ingredients.name: Italian pork sausages
ingredients.original: 500 g Italian pork sausages, casings removed

steps: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan and fry the sausage meat over high heat, breaking it into rough chunks, until deeply browned — about 8 minutes. Leave some pieces whole.
Turn the heat down, add the onion, garlic and fennel seeds and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble away to almost nothing, scraping the base of the pan.
Stir in the cream and simmer gently for 5 minutes while you cook the rigatoni in well-salted boiling water until al dente.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water, and toss it through the sauce with the parmesan, loosening with pasta water until it coats every tube.
Season, fold through the parsley and serve straight away.
